activity_summary: You stayed at the lodging. The king was at the Theatre at two, and you were not in it. Dinner at her table was the standing threepence. You did not invent a part for an afternoon the bill had already settled.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stayed in, and refused a part.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named the threepence, and the casement.

entities.name: Richard III
entities.context: Mentioned in The king, without you

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Richard the Third, at two. I am not in it

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: Threepence, the same as any meal you take in this house
